Constructed from heavy gauge high carbon steel, that has undergone hardening and tempering processes to ensure exceptional wear resistance. Further polishing ensures a smooth, clean finish for weathertight and tidier looking brick joints. Dual-end design offers the convenience of both a 19mm (¾") and 22mm (⁷⁄₈") working end.
